Setup guide

Get an AI key step by step,
and use {{名}} free forever.

Captions don't need a key, just install and go. Translation, AI answers, and notes need an AI service. After the free 1 session runs out, follow this page to set it up in 5 minutes, then it's free forever.

Pick a provider first

In China, we recommend DeepSeek: cheap, good at Chinese, no overseas network needed. If you already have ChatGPT Plus, just log in with your account, that's the easiest.

{1}
ServiceBest for

Get a DeepSeek key

  1. Open platform.deepseek.com and log in with your phone number

    First login registers automatically.

  2. Top up a little money

    Click Top up on the left; 10 yuan lasts a long time, a one-hour meeting costs about a few dimes.

  3. Create an API key

    Click API keys on the left, then Create API key; name it anything, like MeetCaption.

    platform.deepseek.com/api_keys
    API keysCreate API key
  4. Copy the key

    It's shown only once, copy it; it starts with sk-.

    sk-3f9a••••••••••••••••c21eCopy

Enter it in {{名}}

  1. Open Membership in settings, choose Your own key under usage; then go to Account & AI
  2. Click DeepSeek and paste your key
    {2}DeepSeekCheap, good at Chinese
    sk-3f9a••••c21eTest AI service
  3. Click Test; when you see Ready to use, you're all set

Use a ChatGPT account

Have ChatGPT Plus or Pro? In settings under AI service, choose ChatGPT account, click Log in, and you'll come back automatically after logging in via browser. Translation and answers use your subscription quota, no extra cost.

Optional: cloud recognition

The default local recognition is free and works offline, good enough most of the time. In noisy meeting rooms, with heavy accents, or for foreign languages like German or Japanese, you can switch to cloud recognition: in settings under Speech recognition, enter a Soniox API key (60 languages), or Doubao's App ID and Access Token, or an OpenAI key. Members don't need to enter anything, cloud recognition (Soniox) is included.

Is my key safe? Your key is stored only on your computer and never uploaded to us. Sentences go directly from your computer to the provider you choose.

Unfamiliar terms

API key: A password-like string from the provider; the app uses it to call AI on your behalf, and you pay for what you use.
Local recognition: Converts speech to text on your computer, no internet, no cost.
Cloud recognition: Sends audio to the provider for transcription, more accurate in noisy places, billed by duration.
